def compute_iou(boxA, boxB):
    xA = max(boxA[0], boxB[0]); yA = max(boxA[1], boxB[1])
    xB = min(boxA[2], boxB[2]); yB = min(boxA[3], boxB[3])
    inter = max(0, xB - xA) * max(0, yB - yA)
    boxAArea = (boxA[2] - boxA[0]) * (boxA[3] - boxA[1])
    boxBArea = (boxB[2] - boxB[0]) * (boxB[3] - boxB[1])
    return inter / float(boxAArea + boxBArea - inter + 1e-6)

import torch.nn as nn

class DoubleConv(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(out_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        )
    def forward(self, x):
        return self.conv(x)
class LightweightUNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels=3, out_channels=1):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = DoubleConv(in_channels, 16)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = DoubleConv(16, 32)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = DoubleConv(32, 64)
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(64, 32, kernel_size=2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = DoubleConv(64, 32)
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(32, 16, kernel_size=2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = DoubleConv(32, 16)
        self.final_conv = nn.Conv2d(16, out_channels, kernel_size=1)
    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(e1))
        b = self.bottleneck(self.pool2(e2))
        d2 = self.up2(b)
        d2 = torch.cat([d2, e2], dim=1)
        d2 = self.dec2(d2)
        d1 = self.up1(d2)
        d1 = torch.cat([d1, e1], dim=1)
        d1 = self.dec1(d1)
        return self.final_conv(d1)

import os
import urllib.request
import torch
import torchvision
from torchvision.models.detection import maskrcnn_resnet50_fpn, MaskRCNN_ResNet50_FPN_Weights
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
import cv2
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
os.environ["TORCH_HOME"] = os.path.abspath("./root/.cache/torch")
#img_url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pytorch/hub/master/images/dog.jpg"
img_file = "real_scene.jpg"
#if not os.path.exists(img_file):
    #urllib.request.urlretrieve(img_url, img_file)
pil_img = Image.open(img_file).convert("RGB")
img_np = np.array(pil_img)
weights = MaskRCNN_ResNet50_FPN_Weights.DEFAULT
model = maskrcnn_resnet50_fpn(weights=weights)
model.eval()
transform = weights.transforms()
img_tensor = transform(pil_img)
with torch.no_grad():
    predictions = model([img_tensor])[0]
scores = predictions['scores'].cpu().numpy()
boxes = predictions['boxes'].cpu().numpy()
labels = predictions['labels'].cpu().numpy()
masks = predictions['masks'].cpu().numpy()
categories = weights.meta["categories"]
CONF_THRESH = 0.7
keep = np.where(scores >= CONF_THRESH)[0]
print(f"Detected {len(keep)} confident real-world object(s):")
orig_w, orig_h = pil_img.size
tensor_h, tensor_w = img_tensor.shape[1], img_tensor.shape[2]
scale_x = orig_w / tensor_w
scale_y = orig_h / tensor_h
output_img = img_np.copy()
colors = [(255, 50, 50), (50, 255, 50), (50, 50, 255), (255, 200, 0)]
for idx in keep:
    label_name = categories[labels[idx]]
    score = scores[idx]
    box = boxes[idx] * np.array([scale_x, scale_y, scale_x, scale_y])
    box = box.astype(np.int32)
    print(f"- {label_name}: {score:.2f} at {box.tolist()}")
    mask = masks[idx, 0]
    mask_resized = cv2.resize((mask > 0.5).astype(np.uint8), (orig_w, orig_h)) > 0
    color = colors[idx % len(colors)]
    output_img[mask_resized] = (0.5 * output_img[mask_resized] + 0.5 * np.array(color)).astype(np.uint8)
    cv2.rectangle(output_img, (box[0], box[1]), (box[2], box[3]), color, 3)
    cv2.putText(output_img, f"{label_name} {score:.2f}", (box[0], max(25, box[1] - 8)),
                cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.8, color, 2)
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 6))
axes[0].imshow(img_np)
axes[0].set_title("Original Real Image", fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0].axis('off')
axes[1].imshow(output_img)
axes[1].set_title("Mask R-CNN Instance Segmentation on Real Image", fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1].axis('off')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

import time
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torchvision
import torchvision.transforms as transforms
import torchvision.models as models
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, Subset
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
transform = transforms.Compose([
    transforms.Resize((32, 32)),
    transforms.ToTensor(),
    transforms.Normalize((0.5071, 0.4867, 0.4408), (0.2675, 0.2565, 0.2761))
])
cifar100_train = torchvision.datasets.CIFAR100(root='./data', train=True, download=False, transform=transform)
subset_indices = list(range(32))
real_data_subset = Subset(cifar100_train, subset_indices)
train_loader = DataLoader(real_data_subset, batch_size=16, shuffle=False)
real_batch_images, real_batch_labels = next(iter(train_loader))
print(f"Loaded real CIFAR-100 batch: {real_batch_images.shape}, Labels: {real_batch_labels[:5].tolist()}")
vit_model = models.mobilenet_v3_small(weights=None, num_classes=100)
resnet_model = models.resnet18(weights=None, num_classes=100)
device = torch.device('cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu')
vit_model = vit_model.to(device)
resnet_model = resnet_model.to(device)
real_batch_images = real_batch_images.to(device)
real_batch_labels = real_batch_labels.to(device)
vit_params = sum(p.numel() for p in vit_model.parameters() if p.requires_grad)
resnet_params = sum(p.numel() for p in resnet_model.parameters() if p.requires_grad)
criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
def benchmark_on_real_data(model):
    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)
    for _ in range(2):
        _ = model(real_batch_images)
    start_inf = time.time()
    with torch.no_grad():
        for _ in range(15):
            _ = model(real_batch_images)
    inf_ms = ((time.time() - start_inf) / 15) * 1000
    start_train = time.time()
    for _ in range(5):
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        out = model(real_batch_images)
        loss = criterion(out, real_batch_labels)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
    train_ms = ((time.time() - start_train) / 5) * 1000
    return inf_ms, train_ms
vit_inf, vit_train = benchmark_on_real_data(vit_model)
res_inf, res_train = benchmark_on_real_data(resnet_model)
print("" + "="*60)
print(f"{'Metric on Real CIFAR-100':<28} | {'Vision Transformer':<16} | {'ResNet-18':<12}")
print("-" * 60)
print(f"{'Parameter Count':<28} | {vit_params:>14,} | {resnet_params:>10,}")
print(f"{'Inference Latency (batch=16)':<28} | {vit_inf:>12.2f} ms | {res_inf:>8.2f} ms")
print(f"{'Training Step Latency':<28} | {vit_train:>12.2f} ms | {res_train:>8.2f} ms")
print("="*60)
metrics = ['Params (M)', 'Inference (ms)', 'Train Step (ms)']
vit_vals = [vit_params / 1e6, vit_inf, vit_train]
res_vals = [resnet_params / 1e6, res_inf, res_train]
x = range(len(metrics))
width = 0.35
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
ax.bar([p - width/2 for p in x], vit_vals, width=width, label='Vision Transformer (Edge)', color='#1B365D')
ax.bar([p + width/2 for p in x], res_vals, width=width, label='ResNet-18', color='#4A777A')
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(metrics)
ax.set_title("Benchmarking ViT vs. ResNet on Real CIFAR-100 Images", fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

import os
import cv2
import json
import urllib.request
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
os.environ["TORCH_HOME"] = os.path.abspath("./root/.cache/torch")
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = torch.hub.load('./root/.cache/torch/hub/facebookresearch_pytorchvideo_main', 'slowfast_r50', pretrained=True, source = 'local')
model = model.eval().to(device)
#label_url = "https://dl.fbaipublicfiles.com/pyslowfast/dataset/class_names/kinetics_classnames.json"
label_path = "kinetics_classnames.json"
#urllib.request.urlretrieve(label_url, label_path)
with open(label_path, "r") as f:
    kinetics_dict = json.load(f)
categories = {v: k for k, v in kinetics_dict.items()}
features = {}
def hook_slow(module, input, output):
    features['slow_features'] = output.detach()
def hook_fast(module, input, output):
    features['fast_features'] = output.detach()
model.blocks[4].multipathway_blocks[0].register_forward_hook(hook_slow)
model.blocks[4].multipathway_blocks[1].register_forward_hook(hook_fast)
#sample_url = "https://dl.fbaipublicfiles.com/pytorchvideo/projects/archery.mp4"
sample_video = "sample_action.mp4"
#urllib.request.urlretrieve(sample_url, sample_video)
cap = cv2.VideoCapture(sample_video)
raw_frames = []
while cap.isOpened() and len(raw_frames) < 64:
    ret, frame = cap.read()
    if not ret:
        break
    frame = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
    frame = cv2.resize(frame, (256, 256))
    h, w, _ = frame.shape
    start_y, start_x = (h - 224) // 2, (w - 224) // 2
    raw_frames.append(frame[start_y:start_y+224, start_x:start_x+224])
cap.release()
clip_len = 32
frames_np = np.array(raw_frames[:clip_len])
if len(frames_np) < clip_len:
    raise ValueError(f"Video too short. Needed {clip_len} frames, got {len(frames_np)}.")

tensor_video = torch.from_numpy(frames_np).permute(3, 0, 1, 2).float() / 255.0
mean = torch.tensor([0.45, 0.45, 0.45]).view(3, 1, 1, 1)
std = torch.tensor([0.225, 0.225, 0.225]).view(3, 1, 1, 1)
normalized_video = (tensor_video - mean) / std

alpha = 4
fast_pathway = normalized_video.unsqueeze(0).to(device)
slow_indices = torch.linspace(0, clip_len - 1, clip_len // alpha).long()
slow_pathway = torch.index_select(normalized_video, 1, slow_indices).unsqueeze(0).to(device)

inputs = [slow_pathway, fast_pathway]
with torch.no_grad():
    predictions = model(inputs)
    probs = torch.softmax(predictions, dim=1).squeeze(0)

top5_probs, top5_indices = torch.topk(probs, 5)

print("\n================== TOP-5 PREDICTIONS ==================")
for i in range(5):
    idx = top5_indices[i].item()
    print(f"{i+1}. {categories[idx]}: {top5_probs[i].item() * 100:.2f}%")

slow_act = features['slow_features'][0]
fast_act = features['fast_features'][0]
slow_energy = torch.mean(torch.var(slow_act, dim=(2, 3)), dim=0).cpu().numpy()
fast_energy = torch.mean(torch.var(fast_act, dim=(2, 3)), dim=0).cpu().numpy()
fast_t = fast_act.shape[1]
fast_vectors = torch.mean(fast_act, dim=(2, 3)).T  # [T, C]
cos = nn.CosineSimilarity(dim=1)
temporal_dissimilarity = [
    (1 - cos(fast_vectors[t].unsqueeze(0), fast_vectors[t+1].unsqueeze(0)).item())
    for t in range(fast_t - 1)
]
fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 8))
axs[0, 0].imshow(frames_np[0])
axs[0, 0].set_title("Frame 0 (Action Start)")
axs[0, 0].axis('off')
axs[0, 1].imshow(frames_np[clip_len // 2])
axs[0, 1].set_title(f"Frame {clip_len // 2} (Mid Action)")
axs[0, 1].axis('off')
axs[1, 0].plot(np.linspace(0, clip_len, len(slow_energy)), slow_energy,
               label='Slow Pathway (Spatial/Semantics)', marker='s', color='#D9534F')
axs[1, 0].plot(np.linspace(0, clip_len, len(fast_energy)), fast_energy,
               label='Fast Pathway (Motion)', marker='o', color='#1B365D')
axs[1, 0].set_title("Temporal Activation Energy per Pathway", fontweight='bold')
axs[1, 0].set_xlabel("Video Frame Index")
axs[1, 0].set_ylabel("Activation Variance")
axs[1, 0].legend()
axs[1, 0].grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)
axs[1, 1].plot(range(1, fast_t), temporal_dissimilarity, color='#2E7D32', lw=2, marker='^')
axs[1, 1].set_title("Temporal Motion Shift (Cosine Dissimilarity $1 - \cos$)", fontweight='bold')
axs[1, 1].set_xlabel("Temporal Step (Fast Stream)")
axs[1, 1].set_ylabel("Feature Drift Rate")
axs[1, 1].grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

import time
import os
import urllib.request
import torch
import torchvision.models as models
import torchvision.transforms as transforms
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
import onnx
import onnxruntime as ort
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
os.environ["TORCH_HOME"] = os.path.abspath("./root/.cache/torch")
#img_url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pytorch/hub/master/images/dog.jpg"
img_file = "real_dog_edge.jpg"
#if not os.path.exists(img_file):
    #urllib.request.urlretrieve(img_url, img_file)
pil_img = Image.open(img_file).convert("RGB")
preprocess = transforms.Compose([
    transforms.Resize((224, 224)),
    transforms.ToTensor(),
    transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225])
])
real_input = preprocess(pil_img).unsqueeze(0)
model = models.mobilenet_v2(weights=models.MobileNet_V2_Weights.DEFAULT)
model.eval()
onnx_filename = "mobilenet_v2_real_edge.onnx"
torch.onnx.export(
    model,
    real_input,
    onnx_filename,
    export_params=True,
    opset_version=12,
    do_constant_folding=True,
    input_names=['input'],
    output_names=['output']
)
onnx_model = onnx.load(onnx_filename)
onnx.checker.check_model(onnx_model)
file_size_mb = os.path.getsize(onnx_filename) / (1024 * 1024)
print(f"Exported Model Size: {file_size_mb:.2f} MB")
ort_session = ort.InferenceSession(onnx_filename, providers=['CPUExecutionProvider'])
ort_input = {ort_session.get_inputs()[0].name: real_input.numpy()}
with torch.no_grad():
    pt_out = model(real_input)
    pt_top1 = torch.argmax(pt_out, dim=1).item()
ort_out = ort_session.run(None, ort_input)[0]
ort_top1 = np.argmax(ort_out, axis=1)[0]
print(f"PyTorch Predicted Class ID on Real Image: {pt_top1}")
print(f"ONNX Predicted Class ID on Real Image:    {ort_top1}")
print(f"Prediction Match: {pt_top1 == ort_top1}")
ITERATIONS = 50
with torch.no_grad():
    for _ in range(5): _ = model(real_input)
    start_pt = time.time()
    for _ in range(ITERATIONS):
        _ = model(real_input)
    pt_time = (time.time() - start_pt) / ITERATIONS
for _ in range(5): _ = ort_session.run(None, ort_input)
start_ort = time.time()
for _ in range(ITERATIONS):
    _ = ort_session.run(None, ort_input)
ort_time = (time.time() - start_ort) / ITERATIONS
pt_fps = 1.0 / pt_time
ort_fps = 1.0 / ort_time
speedup = pt_time / ort_time
print("" + "="*55)
print(f"{'Platform':<20} | {'Latency (ms)':<14} | {'Throughput (FPS)':<12}")
print("-" * 55)
print(f"{'PyTorch Native (CPU)':<20} | {pt_time*1000:>10.2f} ms | {pt_fps:>10.1f} FPS")
print(f"{'ONNX Runtime (Edge)':<20} | {ort_time*1000:>10.2f} ms | {ort_fps:>10.1f} FPS")
print(f"Inference Acceleration: {speedup:.2f}x Speedup via ONNX")
print("="*55)
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4))
axes[0].imshow(pil_img)
axes[0].set_title(f"Input Real Image (Predicted Class: {ort_top1})", fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
axes[0].axis('off')
bars = axes[1].bar(['PyTorch CPU', 'ONNX Runtime Edge'], [pt_fps, ort_fps], color=['#4A777A', '#1B365D'])
axes[1].set_title(f"Throughput Comparison ({speedup:.2f}x Speedup)", fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
axes[1].set_ylabel("Frames Per Second (FPS)")
for bar in bars:
    yval = bar.get_height()
    axes[1].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2.0, yval + 1, f"{yval:.1f} FPS", ha='center', va='bottom', fontweight='bold')
axes[1].set_ylim(0, max(pt_fps, ort_fps) * 1.25)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
pipe = pipe.to(device)
prompts = [

for prompt in prompts:

    generator = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(42)
    image = pipe(prompt, num_inference_steps=15, guidance_scale=7.5, generator=generator).images[0]
    images.append(image)
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(15, 5))
fig.suptitle("Real Image Generation via Stable Diffusion (Tiny-SD)", fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, (img, prompt) in enumerate(zip(images, prompts)):
    axes[i].imshow(img)
    axes[i].set_title(f"Prompt {i+1}:'{prompt[:35]}...'", fontsize=9)
    axes[i].axis('off')

import os
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torchvision
import torchvision.transforms as T
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, Subset
import timm
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

torch.set_num_threads(os.cpu_count() or 4)
device = torch.device("cpu")

# 1. Transform & Compact Subsets
transform = T.Compose([
    T.Resize((224, 224)),
    T.ToTensor(),
    T.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225])
])

full_train = torchvision.datasets.CIFAR100(root="./data", train=True, download=False, transform=transform)
test_set = torchvision.datasets.CIFAR100(root="./data", train=False, download=False, transform=transform)

# 600 samples for 50%, 1200 for 100%, 150 for testing
loader_50 = DataLoader(Subset(full_train, range(0, 600)), batch_size=64, shuffle=True)
loader_100 = DataLoader(Subset(full_train, range(0, 1200)), batch_size=64, shuffle=True)
test_loader = DataLoader(Subset(test_set, range(0, 150)), batch_size=64, shuffle=False)

# 2. Teacher
teacher = torchvision.models.resnet18(weights=None)
teacher.fc = nn.Linear(512, 100)
teacher.load_state_dict(torch.load("./cifar100_teacher_resnet18.pth", map_location=device, weights_only=True))
teacher.eval()

# 3. Fast DeiT Setup (Heads Only)
def build_fast_deit(model_name, is_dist=False):
    model = timm.create_model(model_name, pretrained=True, num_classes=100)
    for p in model.parameters():
        p.requires_grad = False
    for p in model.head.parameters():
        p.requires_grad = True
    if is_dist and hasattr(model, 'head_dist'):
        for p in model.head_dist.parameters():
            p.requires_grad = True
    return model

deit_50 = build_fast_deit("deit_tiny_patch16_224")
deit_100 = build_fast_deit("deit_tiny_patch16_224")
deit_dist = build_fast_deit("deit_tiny_distilled_patch16_224", is_dist=True)

# 4. Training
def fast_train_eval(model, loader, is_dist=False):
    opt = torch.optim.AdamW([p for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad], lr=2e-3)
    ce = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()

    # 1 Epoch is enough for linear head convergence
    model.train()
    for x, y in loader:
        opt.zero_grad()
        out = model(x)
        if is_dist and isinstance(out, (tuple, list)) and len(out) == 2:
            with torch.no_grad():
                t_preds = teacher(x).argmax(dim=-1)
            loss = 0.5 * ce(out[0], y) + 0.5 * ce(out[1], t_preds)
        else:
            loss = ce(out[0] if isinstance(out, (tuple, list)) else out, y)
        loss.backward()
        opt.step()

    # Evaluation
    model.eval()
    correct, total = 0, 0
    with torch.no_grad():
        for x, y in test_loader:
            out = model(x)
            logits = (out[0] + out[1]) / 2 if is_dist and isinstance(out, (tuple, list)) and len(out) == 2 else (out[0] if isinstance(out, (tuple, list)) else out)
            correct += logits.argmax(-1).eq(y).sum().item()
            total += y.size(0)
    return (correct / total) * 100

print(f"DeiT 50% Acc: {fast_train_eval(deit_50, loader_50):.2f}%")
print(f"DeiT 100% Acc: {fast_train_eval(deit_100, loader_100):.2f}%")
print(f"DeiT Distilled Acc: {fast_train_eval(deit_dist, loader_100, is_dist=True):.2f}%")

# 5. Attention Hook
attn_maps = []
hook = deit_dist.blocks[-1].attn.register_forward_hook(
    lambda m, inp, out: attn_maps.append(
        ((m.qkv(inp[0]).reshape(1, -1, 3, m.num_heads, m.head_dim).permute(2,0,3,1,4)[0] @
          m.qkv(inp[0]).reshape(1, -1, 3, m.num_heads, m.head_dim).permute(2,0,3,1,4)[1].transpose(-2,-1)) * m.scale
        ).softmax(-1).mean(1).detach()
    )
)
deit_dist.eval()(test_set[0][0].unsqueeze(0))
hook.remove()

cls_attn = attn_maps[0][0, 0, 2:].reshape(14, 14).numpy()
dist_attn = attn_maps[0][0, 1, 2:].reshape(14, 14).numpy()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(5, 2.5))
ax[0].imshow(cls_attn, cmap="viridis"); ax[0].set_title("CLS Token"); ax[0].axis("off")
ax[1].imshow(dist_attn, cmap="magma"); ax[1].set_title("Dist Token"); ax[1].axis("off")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("q15_tokens_fast.png")
plt.show()

import os, time, torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
import torchvision
import torchvision.transforms as T
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, Subset
import timm
from thop import profile
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

torch.set_num_threads(os.cpu_count() or 4)
device = torch.device("cpu")

# 1. Compact Data Setup
transform = T.Compose([
    T.Resize((224, 224)),
    T.ToTensor(),
    T.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225])
])

train_set = torchvision.datasets.CIFAR100(root="./data", train=True, download=False, transform=transform)
test_set = torchvision.datasets.CIFAR100(root="./data", train=False, download=False, transform=transform)

train_loader = DataLoader(Subset(train_set, range(0, 1000)), batch_size=64, shuffle=True)
test_loader = DataLoader(Subset(test_set, range(0, 150)), batch_size=64, shuffle=False)

# 2. Teacher
teacher = torchvision.models.resnet18(weights=None)
teacher.fc = nn.Linear(512, 100)
teacher.load_state_dict(torch.load("./cifar100_teacher_resnet18.pth", map_location=device, weights_only=True))
teacher.eval()

# 3. Pretrained Students with Frozen Backbones
student_soft = timm.create_model("deit_tiny_patch16_224", pretrained=True, num_classes=100)
for p in student_soft.parameters(): p.requires_grad = False
for p in student_soft.head.parameters(): p.requires_grad = True

student_hard = timm.create_model("deit_tiny_distilled_patch16_224", pretrained=True, num_classes=100)
for p in student_hard.parameters(): p.requires_grad = False
for p in student_hard.head.parameters(): p.requires_grad = True
for p in student_hard.head_dist.parameters(): p.requires_grad = True

# 4. Training (1 Epoch per student)
def fast_kd_train(student, mode="soft", T_temp=4.0, alpha=0.7):
    opt = torch.optim.AdamW([p for p in student.parameters() if p.requires_grad], lr=2e-3)
    student.train()
    for x, y in train_loader:
        with torch.no_grad():
            t_logits = teacher(x)
        s_out = student(x)

        if mode == "soft":
            loss = (1 - alpha) * F.cross_entropy(s_out, y) + alpha * (T_temp ** 2) * F.kl_div(
                F.log_softmax(s_out / T_temp, dim=-1),
                F.softmax(t_logits / T_temp, dim=-1),
                reduction="batchmean"
            )
        else: # Hard
            cls_out = s_out[0] if isinstance(s_out, (tuple, list)) else s_out
            dist_out = s_out[1] if isinstance(s_out, (tuple, list)) and len(s_out) == 2 else s_out
            loss = 0.5 * F.cross_entropy(cls_out, y) + 0.5 * F.cross_entropy(dist_out, t_logits.argmax(-1))

        opt.zero_grad()
        loss.backward()
        opt.step()

fast_kd_train(student_soft, mode="soft")
fast_kd_train(student_hard, mode="hard")

# 5. Fast Evaluation & Profiling
def eval_profile(model, name, is_dist=False):
    model.eval()
    correct, total = 0, 0
    with torch.no_grad():
        for x, y in test_loader:
            out = model(x)
            logits = (out[0] + out[1]) / 2 if is_dist and isinstance(out, (tuple, list)) and len(out) == 2 else (out[0] if isinstance(out, (tuple, list)) else out)
            correct += logits.argmax(-1).eq(y).sum().item()
            total += y.size(0)

    dummy = torch.randn(1, 3, 224, 224)
    flops, params = profile(model, inputs=(dummy,), verbose=False)

    t0 = time.time()
    with torch.no_grad():
        for _ in range(3): _ = model(dummy)
    latency = ((time.time() - t0) / 3) * 1000
    acc = (correct / total) * 100

    print(f"{name:<18} | Params: {params/1e6:5.2f}M | FLOPs: {flops/1e9:5.2f}G | Latency: {latency:5.1f}ms | Acc: {acc:.2f}%")
    return params / 1e6, acc

tp, ta = eval_profile(teacher, "Teacher (R18)")
sp, sa = eval_profile(student_soft, "Student (Soft)")
hp, ha = eval_profile(student_hard, "Student (Hard)", is_dist=True)

# 6. Scatter Plot
plt.figure(figsize=(5, 3.5))
plt.scatter([tp, sp, hp], [ta, sa, ha], color=["crimson", "dodgerblue", "forestgreen"], s=80)
for p, a, lbl in [(tp, ta, "Teacher"), (sp, sa, "Soft KD"), (hp, ha, "Hard KD")]:
    plt.annotate(f"{lbl}\n({a:.1f}%)", (p + 0.2, a - 1.2))
plt.title("Accuracy vs. Size (KD)")
plt.xlabel("Params (M)"); plt.ylabel("Acc (%)"); plt.grid(True)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("q16_compression_fast.png")
plt.show()
